cohort: Pregnant individuals who delivered at or beyond 28 completed weeks of gestation at Mamata Medical College, Khammam, Telangana State, India, over a 5-year period.
finding: Robson's Ten-Group Classification System (RTGCS) group X contributed the most (31.10%) to total cesarean deliveries, followed by group V (29.43%), group II (20.95%), and group I (6.68%).
